content.short: Underdog Protocol enables developers and projects to easily integrate dynamic NFTs into any product or workflow.
content.description: Underdog Protocol offers a gasless API to create, update, and manage dynamic or soulbound NFTs while connecting on-chain and off-chain workflows. Developers can integrate NFTs with familiar web2 tools like Zapier, Discord, Telegram, and Notion to centralize user activity and engagement in one place. This approach simplifies NFT management, automation, and cross-tool coordination for communities and teams. It is trusted by SuperteamDAO, Parcl, and Dispatch Forums.
content.meta: Underdog Protocol provides a gasless API to create dynamic or soulbound NFTs, manage NFTs, and connect off-chain workflows. Discover Underdog Protocol and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
